⚠️ Spec discrepancy found in #backend Slack discussion:

The doc says Enterprise = 1000 req/min, but per a thread in #backend (U58C61147, ~Jul 14), load testing showed 3x headroom on the new inference cluster. Enterprise was bumped to 2500 req/min in the gateway config, and UA2DAB7B8 confirmed they would update the SDK docs to reflect 2500.

This doc has not been updated to reflect the new Enterprise tier limit of 2500 req/min.

⚠️ Out of date — Enterprise tier limit changed from 1000 to 2500 req/min.

In #backend (Jul 14), U58C61147 posted load test results showing 3x headroom on the new inference cluster. In the thread, they confirmed bumping Enterprise to 2500 req/min in the gateway config, and UA2DAB7B8 said they'd update the SDK docs. This spec still shows 1000.

⚠️ Out of date — burst window changed from 60 seconds to 10 seconds.

In #backend (~Jul 16), U38FFB92B announced they pushed the burst window change to prod: went from 60s down to 10s. They noted the shorter window immediately dropped the abuse patterns Elena had flagged. Staging metrics were clean so it shipped. The doc still says 60-second burst window.

⚠️ Out of date — X-RateLimit-Reset header was replaced with standard Retry-After header.

In #backend (~Jul 13), UA2DAB7B8 said they swapped out X-RateLimit-Reset for the standard Retry-After header in the middleware. Rationale: every HTTP client already supports Retry-After natively. The other two rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining) stay as-is. This doc still lists X-RateLimit-Reset.

❓ Needs clarification — possible Free tier limit change?

In #backend (~Jul 9), U016D85BC said "I wonder if 2500 is too high for the free tier though. Seems generous." This was posted shortly after the Enterprise bump to 2500 was discussed, so it's ambiguous whether Free was also changed to 2500 or if this was just a musing. The doc still shows Free = 100 req/min. Worth confirming with U016D85BC whether Free was actually changed.
